title: SEC0: blob_download_handler rejects "a-self" account ID alias
description: kithd/src/lib.rs blob_download_handler line 158: the handler checks account_id != state.owner_id and returns 400 for any other value. The session object (kith-jmap/src/lib.rs line 207-209) advertises downloadUrl as {base}/jmap/download/{accountId}/{blobId}/{name} and exposes the account under the key "a-self". A client correctly substituting "a-self" as the accountId template will always get 400 on download, while upload (blob.rs line 38) correctly accepts both "a-self" and state.owner_id. Fix: accept "a-self" as an alias in blob_download_handler, mirroring blob_upload_handler.
